meta.name: phase-complete
meta.description: Run the full deep quality gate after completing an implementation phase — review, fix, test, report, squash-commit. Principal approval REQUIRED before commit (phase boundary is NOT auto-approved). Auto-emits phase-complete dispatch to captain for PR landing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动执行阶段质量门禁，审批后提交代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果开发流程需要严格的代码审查和测试门禁
copy.tagline_en: Run a full quality gate after each implementation phase, requiring approval before commit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your development workflow requires a rigorous code review and test gate

howto.what: 装上后，完成一个实施阶段时，Claude 会运行深度质量门（审查、修复、测试、报告、压缩提交），必须获得主体审批后才提交，并自动向管理员发送阶段完成通知。
howto.when: 当你完成一个阶段的所有迭代，并输入命令 “/phase-complete <阶段>: <描述>” 时触发。

say.note: 运行完整质量门，等待审批后提交并通知管理员。
对该阶段进行审查、修复、测试并提交。

howto.what_en: After completing an implementation phase, Claude runs a deep quality gate (review, fix, test, report, squash-commit), requires principal approval before commit, then auto-emits a phase-complete dispatch to captain for PR landing.
howto.when_en: When you have finished all iterations in a phase and invoke the /phase-complete command with a phase identifier and description.
